# Defeater Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DefeaterKind`](gmeow-DefeaterKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DefeaterKind>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The Pollock kind of a defeater — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses): [`gmeow:defeaterRebutting`](../individuals/gmeow-defeaterRebutting.md) (attacks the conclusion directly, giving reason to believe its negation) and [`gmeow:defeaterUndercutting`](../individuals/gmeow-defeaterUndercutting.md) (attacks the inferential link, removing the warrant without asserting the negation). Carried as a [`gmeow:defeaterKind`](../properties/gmeow-defeaterKind.md) value on a defeating [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DefeaterKind`](gmeow-DefeaterKind.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
